# host.yml's artifact folders only (docs/85, docs/87)
des_host.exe   # the host exe
des_host.map   # its linker map
des_host       # the Linux host
libSDL2-2.0.so.0       # SDL2, built from its pinned source, beside the Linux host
libvkd3d.so.1          # vkd3d, built from its pinned source, beside the Linux host
libvkd3d-shader.so.1   # vkd3d's shader compiler, likewise
libvkd3d-utils.so.1    # vkd3d's helpers, likewise
libavcodec.so.62       # FFmpeg's codec library (MPEG-2 video only), built from its pinned release, beside the Linux host
libavutil.so.60        # FFmpeg's utility library, likewise
avcodec-62.dll         # FFmpeg's codec library (MPEG-2 video only), built from its pinned release, beside the Windows host
avutil-60.dll          # FFmpeg's utility library, likewise
